rulings.restated: Enter the amount from f1040 line 7a.
rulings.model: The form says only 'Net gain or loss from disposition of property (see instructions)', and the line 5a instructions are not in the pages given. Without them it cannot be confirmed that Form 1040 line 7a (capital gain or loss, after the loss limit and including capital gain distributions) is the right amount.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; project retained. The dispositions of property in net investment income within the slice are the securities sales and capital gain distributions Schedule D carries to Form 1040 line 7a; every other disposition or adjustment (i8960 p. 9, line 5a) is refused by `f8960.unsupported` ("Any annuity, rental, royalty, business/pass-through income, CFC/PFIC holding, section 911 exclusion, disposition adjustment, NOL or other NIIT modification outside this slice?"). No change to the data.
